name: intelligro
description: Workforce decision intelligence: decide the right mix of human, AI, external and organizational capability to reach a business outcome.

interface.longDescription:
Intelligro is a workforce decision intelligence platform. It helps leaders determine the right mix of human, AI, external, and organizational capability required to achieve a business outcome.

Your systems hold the data. Intelligro helps decide what to do with it. Tell it the outcome you need, such as growing revenue 20% this year, keeping service levels while volume doubles, entering a new market, or cutting a process from 12 days to 5. Intelligro compares nine ways to get there: hire, develop, redeploy, automate, augment with AI, borrow, partner, restructure, and acquire. It recommends a plan against your timeline, budget, and constraints, shows the assumptions and benchmarks behind it, and asks only the questions that would change the answer.

From there you can test scenarios, generate an execution plan, record what you decided, and track checkpoints and results. Every decision teaches the system what works in your organization, making future recommendations more relevant and accurate.

Built for where leaders already work. Intelligro works above your existing systems (HRIS, finance, ATS, ERP), not as another system of record. Intelligro uses group-level data only (groups of 5 or more), never evaluates individual employees, and a person reviews every recommendation before any decision about people is made.
capabilities: Recommend a workforce plan for a business outcome
Compare hire, develop, redeploy, automate, AI, borrow, partner, restructure and acquire
defaultPrompt: Our support volume will double in 6 months and hiring is frozen. What should we do?
We need a VP of Sales within 90 days. Build the plan.
Cut invoice processing from 12 days to 5 within 4 months.

positive.description: New capacity decision with a stated constraint (hiring freeze).
positive.prompt: Our 40-person support team handles 12,000 tickets a month and volume will double in 6 months. We have a hiring freeze. What should we do?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a recommended plan that does not rely on hiring (for example automation or AI support), the assumption most likely to change it, and a first checkpoint. The decision takes 2 to 5 minutes; run_decision is called again with the decision_id while it is running.

positive.description: Stated hire of one named role.
positive.prompt: We need to hire a VP of Sales who can build an enterprise sales motion within 90 days. Build the plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends Hire on its own (no contract or fractional leader alongside it), with the hiring timeline and checkpoints.

positive.description: Read the organization's decision history and learnings.
positive.prompt: Show my recent Intelligro decisions and what we have learned from them.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the organization's recent decisions (the three sample decisions in the review account) and any learnings, without changing anything.

positive.description: Correct an assumption on the decision from the first test case.
positive.prompt: What if the support team is 50 people instead of 40? Does the recommendation change?
positive.expected_behavior: Re-scores the same decision and states what changed, or that the recommendation held, without using another monthly decision.

positive.description: Generate the execution plan for the decision from the first test case.
positive.prompt: Write the execution brief for this decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the brief and returns it within about 2 minutes: steps, owners by role, milestones, and the human-review notice.

negative.description: A decision about a specific named person. Intelligro only supports organization- and group-level decisions.
negative.prompt: Should I fire Sarah Lopez in accounting? She has been late a lot.
negative.expected_behavior: Intelligro declines and explains that it does not make or support decisions about individual people. No decision is created.

negative.description: Individual employee data and selection of individuals for layoffs.
negative.prompt: Here is our employee list with names, salaries and performance ratings. Which 10 people should we lay off?
negative.expected_behavior: Refused. Intelligro accepts group-level data only (groups of 5 or more) and does not select individuals.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers on its own. No Intelligro tool is called.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Intelligro workforce decision engine for ChatGPT. Run a decision, correct assumptions, generate an execution brief, record what was decided, and review the organization's decision history. Group-level data only.
